queries.name: space-newest
queries.text: space = AA ORDER BY created DESC

queries.name: space-status
queries.text: space = AA AND status = "In Progress" ORDER BY updated DESC

queries.name: mine-open
queries.text: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != done ORDER BY priority DESC, created DESC

queries.name: status-priority-in
queries.text: status IN (Backlog, "To Do") AND priority IN (High, Highest) ORDER BY created DESC

queries.name: labels-in
queries.text: labels IN (security, regression) ORDER BY created DESC

queries.name: summary-contains
queries.text: summary ~ "login" ORDER BY created DESC

queries.name: recent-bugs
queries.text: created >= -30d AND type = Bug ORDER BY created DESC

queries.name: stale-unresolved
queries.text: resolved IS EMPTY AND updated < -90d ORDER BY updated ASC

queries.name: number-gt-sorted
queries.text: "Ethhal number 8" > 500 AND space = AA ORDER BY "Ethhal number 8" DESC

queries.name: option-eq
queries.text: "Xanpir select 2" = "Hintor 3" AND statusCategory = todo ORDER BY created DESC

queries.name: date-window
queries.text: "Ismor date 5" <= endOfMonth() AND "Ismor date 5" >= startOfMonth() ORDER BY "Ismor date 5" ASC

queries.name: user-field-mine
queries.text: "Juneth user 11" = currentUser() ORDER BY updated DESC

queries.name: multi-in
queries.text: "Wenvin multiselect 20" IN ("Jungor 1", "Xanvel 2") AND status != Done ORDER BY created DESC

queries.name: number-empty
queries.text: "Ethhal number 8" IS EMPTY AND type IN (Story, Task) AND space = AA ORDER BY created DESC

queries.name: children
queries.text: parent = 1 ORDER BY created ASC

queries.name: mine-or-reported
queries.text: (assignee = currentUser() OR reporter = currentUser()) AND statusCategory != done ORDER BY updated DESC

queries.name: was-status
queries.text: status WAS "In Review" ORDER BY updated DESC

queries.name: changed-to-after
queries.text: status CHANGED TO Done AFTER -7d ORDER BY updated DESC

queries.name: changed-by-during
queries.text: assignee CHANGED BY 4587 DURING (2024-01-01, 2024-02-01) ORDER BY created DESC

queries.name: not-or-spaces
queries.text: NOT (labels IN (infra) OR type = Subtask) AND space IN (AA, AB) ORDER BY created DESC

queries.name: was-rare
queries.text: status WAS Cancelled AND status = Done ORDER BY updated DESC

queries.name: permitted-half
queries.text: status = Done ORDER BY created DESC
